description: Calibrate a prediction's confidence against historical outcomes. Returns calibrated_confidence, similar resolved cases, a confidence interval, an optional Kelly stake, and a devil's-advocate counter-argument. Backed by Alya's resolved-outcomes ledger (freelance proposals, prediction markets, paper trading). Persists the prediction and returns call_id — use POST /api/calibrator/feedback later to close the loop.

domain.description: Optional domain tag, e.g. 'freelance.proposal.upwork.python', 'prediction-market.politics', 'equities.paper.spy'. Used to filter similar cases.

prediction.description: What you predict will happen (1 sentence).

stakes.description: Optional USD amount at stake; used to compute kelly_stake.

name: calibrate_decision
